operations.name: Calibrate camera intrinsics and distortion
prerequisites: Images cover target orientations and image field
changes_or_infers: Estimates intrinsics and lens-distortion coefficients
Undistorted images are derivatives
checks: Calibration reprojection RMS and per-image residuals
Undistort a held-out target image and compare straight edges
Keep calibration target coordinates in declared units
alternatives: COLMAP self-calibration for capture-derived focal/intrinsic estimates
Manufacturer calibration only when specific camera/lens state is known
operations.summary: Solve camera intrinsics/distortion from corresponding known target coordinates and detected image points; target size supplies metric length scale to later pose solutions.

operations.name: Solve camera pose from known 3D-to-2D correspondences
prerequisites: Intrinsics and distortion from REC-01 or a documented calibration
preserves: World point coordinates and point correspondence labels
changes_or_infers: Estimates rotation and translation from world/object frame to camera frame
checks: Pixel reprojection residuals
Independent target correspondences
Confirm transform direction and camera axes before downstream conversion
alternatives: COLMAP camera poses when point correspondences are not manually surveyed
CAD fiducial detection with PnP for CAD-to-photo registration
operations.summary: Anchor a camera to metric world/CAD coordinates using PnP; output pose is a transform, not a reconstructed surface. OpenCV camera convention is x-right, y-down, z-forward.

operations.name: Estimate camera poses and sparse structure from overlapping photos
prerequisites: Static scene or moving objects masked
Overlap and texture sufficient for feature matching
preserves: Feature and match database, camera model, sparse reconstruction and settings
changes_or_infers: Estimates camera poses and sparse 3D points
Monocular reconstruction scale is arbitrary absent controls/metric sensor
checks: Registered image fraction and component connectivity
Reprojection residual distribution
Camera path and sparse outliers
At least two separated scale controls for local distortion detection
operations.summary: Recover view geometry and camera poses from overlapping images; normalize all exported poses to a named frame and apply scale only from explicit evidence.

operations.name: Convert video into an image reconstruction dataset
prerequisites: Video stream has sufficient viewpoint change
preserves: Frame index and presentation timestamp for every extracted image
changes_or_infers: Selects a frame subset; frame selection can omit views or moving events
checks: Frame sharpness and coverage by viewing direction
Image timestamp monotonicity
Motion/rolling-shutter and exposure consistency
alternatives: DA3-Streaming directly on long image sequences
operations.summary: Create a controlled photo-set from video while retaining original timeline provenance; selected frame sampling is an input transformation that affects camera coverage.

operations.name: Register RGB and depth frames and estimate sequence poses
changes_or_infers: Estimates frame-to-frame motion if poses are not provided
Depth samples are projected into camera coordinates
checks: Known-depth/range baseline residuals
Frame registration residuals and loop closure
Check synchronized frames and depth/color alignment
operations.summary: Associate color and depth in a shared camera model, then estimate or import frame poses for fusion. Sensor metric units do not remove calibration bias or trajectory drift.

operations.name: Integrate calibrated RGB-D frames into point cloud or TSDF mesh
prerequisites: Voxel length and truncation distance chosen in stated units
preserves: Raw depth frames and integration trajectory
changes_or_infers: Fuses samples into voxel representation and interpolated surface
Occluded regions remain unobserved or become algorithmically filled
checks: Independent dimensions and loop-closure drift
Compare two voxel lengths against the same controls
Report registration and surface residual distributions
operations.summary: Fuse RGB-D into a scalable TSDF and extract a triangle mesh; voxel length controls discretization and noise response, not measured accuracy.

operations.name: Estimate coarse transform between point clouds
prerequisites: Same scale or explicitly estimated Sim(3) scale
changes_or_infers: Estimates rigid or chosen similarity transform and correspondences
checks: RANSAC inlier set and correspondence checks
Fitness/inlier RMSE after transform
Control targets withheld from fitting
operations.summary: Find a coarse point-cloud alignment from local features, then pass the transform and inliers to refinement; feature ambiguity and symmetry can produce a plausible wrong pose.

operations.name: Refine registration and compare point-cloud surfaces
prerequisites: ICP threshold selected from expected sampling/noise scale
changes_or_infers: Refines transform to minimize selected correspondence objective
Distance map depends on chosen correspondence and sampling rule
checks: Fitness and inlier RMSE with units
Independent control residuals
Inspect residual map and non-overlap separately
operations.summary: Refine an initialized transform and compute cloud distances; optimizer residual and overlap metrics describe fit to participating points, not absolute truth.

operations.name: Segment point clouds and fit candidate primitive evidence
prerequisites: Segmentation thresholds expressed in cloud units
Target regions have enough spatial coverage
preserves: Point indices for each segment and threshold parameters
changes_or_infers: Classifies points into plane inliers/clusters
Primitive parameters are estimates from sampled observations
checks: Plane/candidate feature residuals and inlier count
Repeat fit at alternative thresholds
Manual check for mixed surfaces and partial arcs
operations.summary: Partition a cloud and obtain candidate planes/clusters; parameters are evidence for a feature interpretation, not automatically semantic CAD.

operations.name: Estimate multi-view depth, camera poses and Gaussian outputs
prerequisites: Appropriate model variant/weights and GPU memory
DA3 Blender add-on currently has no LICENSE file at inspected upstream path
preserves: Prediction confidence, camera poses/intrinsics and model revision
changes_or_infers: Network predicts depth/rays/poses and may estimate metric-scale depth
Splat and mesh outputs from learned model are generated estimates
checks: Compare metric depth to independent measured controls
Inspect confidence and cross-view consistency
Compare camera poses to COLMAP/targets
Record output model representation exactly
operations.summary: Use DA3 for learned depth/pose/geometry and optional splats; its metric series remains an estimate that requires controls for dimensional claims.

operations.name: Train NeRF or Gaussian scene for view synthesis
prerequisites: Camera poses or COLMAP camera solve
GPU for Splatfacto/gsplat; exact memory depends on method and scene
Output command and Nerfstudio version recorded
preserves: Cameras, original images, training config/checkpoint and scene representation
changes_or_infers: Fits one selected NeRF or Gaussian representation
Any extracted mesh is a separate estimated surface derivative
checks: Novel-view coverage and reprojection/render metrics
Compare extracted geometry with controls and independent dense scan
Confirm Splatfacto export support in installed version; upstream pages conflict on mesh/pointcloud availability
alternatives: Keep splat as visual reference only
operations.summary: Train one selected NeRF or Gaussian scene. Mesh/point-cloud extraction is a separate model-dependent operation; generic TSDF documentation conflicts with the Splatfacto FAQ.

operations.name: Register existing CAD to calibrated photographs or scan points
prerequisites: Known CAD units, component datum and exact CAD revision
Visible identifiable CAD landmarks or scan geometry
preserves: Authoritative CAD revision and its units
changes_or_infers: Estimates CAD-to-camera/world transform
Surface registration uses a tessellated derivative of CAD
checks: Independent landmark reprojection residuals
Scan-to-CAD distance map and interface dimensions
Check symmetries/partial overlap for alternate poses
alternatives: Photogrammetric camera solve with control targets
operations.summary: Register a known CAD revision to measured photo landmarks or sampled scan geometry; the source CAD and scan/photo remain separate evidence.

operations.name: Anchor a screen sketch to a 3D surface
prerequisites: Active camera intrinsics and world transform
Semantic meaning chosen: trace, projected curve or planar sketch
preserves: Camera, hit object/component and hit primitive identifier
changes_or_infers: Maps pixel strokes to surface hits; occlusion and target surface define anchors
Curve fitting/simplification changes stroke geometry
checks: Reproject world anchors into source view
Report missed/ambiguous rays and anchor residual
Verify resulting OCS sketch plane and constraints
alternatives: Click measured fiducials and use PnP
Draw on a CAD datum plane
operations.summary: Convert 2D screen strokes into 3D surface anchors by camera ray intersection. Ray hits are calculated anchors whose evidence follows the camera and hit geometry; a separate interpretation step must define sketch plane, constraints and feature meaning.

operations.name: Remodel segmented scan evidence as parametric CAD
preserves: Raw scan, segmentation indices and fit report
changes_or_infers: Replaces noisy sampled boundaries with constrained feature model
Hidden surfaces/functional details require explicit assumptions
checks: OCS readback of geometry/revision
Solid validity and independent dimensions
Scan-to-CAD residual maps by surface and withheld controls
alternatives: Faceted mesh-derived solid when that is the required representation
operations.summary: Use fitted scan geometry as evidence and reconstruct an editable feature history through the existing OCS workflow; fitted parameters must remain traceable and not silently become author dimensions.

operations.name: Reconcile scan surfaces with dimensioned drawings
prerequisites: Common datums, features or control targets
preserves: Drawing and scan as separate evidence sources
Source revision, units and alignment transform
changes_or_infers: Aligns evidence and constrains CAD candidate features
Discrepancies may reflect drawing, manufactured part, scan or interpretation differences
checks: Use some dimensions for fit and reserve others for validation
Report drawing-to-scan residuals and surface coverage
Inspect datum consistency and per-feature outliers
alternatives: Separate variant models by source revision
operations.summary: Use a drawing as dimension evidence and a scan as surface evidence; preserve disagreements and provenance instead of averaging incompatible values without an explicit rule.

operations.name: Iterate CAD edits against registered evidence
prerequisites: Comparison regions and thresholds with units
preserves: Check configuration and dimensional source links
changes_or_infers: Applies bounded CAD edit and computes deltas
checks: Read back edited model
Compare same registered scan/controls across revisions
Report regional max/RMS/quantiles and functional dimension changes
operations.summary: Use a repeatable scan-to-CAD comparison loop while preserving the source and tying every reported deviation to exact model revisions and regions.

operations.name: Build dense point cloud and mesh from SfM camera solution
prerequisites: REC-03 sparse camera solution or equivalent calibrated poses
Overlap, exposure and scene masks retained
Scale supplied by control or metric camera data for dimensional use
preserves: Sparse scene, images, camera poses and dense reconstruction settings
changes_or_infers: Estimates dense visible surface and interpolated mesh
Unseen and occluded surfaces are not recovered from images
checks: Image reprojection and dense coverage
Withheld control lengths and independent cloud residuals
Compare mesh-to-cloud distances and disconnected components
alternatives: Nerfstudio geometry extraction only where model support is established
operations.summary: Run dense multi-view stereo after sparse camera recovery. Dense geometry inherits the camera scale and pose errors; triangulation does not itself create metric evidence.

operations.name: Generate a single-image mesh proxy
prerequisites: Exactly one selected image and model revision recorded
Model weights and model terms recorded separately from source-code licence
Dimensions or measured controls supplied separately before dimensional CAD use
changes_or_infers: Predicts backside and occluded geometry from learned priors
Mesh scale is not established by image appearance alone
checks: Compare silhouette with additional views
Compare explicitly measured dimensions
Mark hidden surfaces as inferred before CAD remodeling
operations.summary: Generate a visual mesh proxy from one image. The output is inferred geometry with no independent metric scale.

operations.name: Train and export a Gaussian splat scene
prerequisites: GPU sized for the selected scene/model
Nerfstudio version and export command recorded
preserves: Images, poses, configuration, checkpoint and Gaussian PLY
changes_or_infers: Fits view-dependent Gaussian representation from capture images
Does not produce analytic CAD surfaces
checks: Novel-view coverage and held-out render comparison
Pose/image consistency
Keep dimensional claims tied to independent controls
operations.summary: Train one Gaussian scene and export its supported Gaussian representation. Current Splatfacto docs support Gaussian PLY; they state mesh/point-cloud export is unsupported.

operations.name: Train and export a NeRF scene
preserves: Images, poses, training configuration and checkpoint
changes_or_infers: Fits radiance field for view synthesis
Scene geometry extraction is a separate model-dependent process
checks: Novel-view coverage and held-out render comparison
Check extracted geometry separately against measured controls
operations.summary: Train one NeRF scene for view synthesis. A NeRF checkpoint is not itself an editable CAD surface.

recipes.name: Calibrated photos and controls to editable CAD
recipes.goal: Recover camera poses, a dense surface, and an editable feature interpretation using measured controls.
handoffs: REC-01 uses calibration-target images in the photo set and known target coordinates in the measurement set.
REC-03 supplies sparse poses/cloud; REC-17 supplies dense point cloud and mesh.
REC-14 and REC-16 use the supplied measurements and the dense surface; retain withheld controls for checks.
recipes.summary: Photo set and measured controls are the actual job inputs; sparse and dense geometry are produced by the listed stages before CAD remodeling.

recipes.name: Video and RGB-D to registered metric scene
recipes.goal: Align sampled video frames and calibrated depth geometry into one scene, then compare their surfaces.
handoffs: REC-04 makes the photo set; REC-03 estimates photo poses/cloud; REC-05 estimates depth poses/cloud.
REC-07 aligns those two clouds; REC-08 refines and reports residuals; REC-06 fuses depth frames with their trajectory.
Use sensor calibration and withheld measured controls for scale and drift checks.
recipes.summary: Video frames and calibrated depth frames are inputs; each registration and fusion stage consumes produced pose/cloud evidence.

recipes.name: Existing CAD aligned to calibrated photos
recipes.goal: Place a known CAD revision into captured views and quantify projection residuals.
handoffs: Measurement set contains 3D CAD landmark coordinates and corresponding image pixels.
REC-12 uses the CAD source, calibrated photo set and correspondences; validate on withheld landmarks.
recipes.summary: Register a supplied CAD revision to calibrated photos; the result is a pose and residual set, not new hidden geometry.

recipes.name: Scan and dimensioned drawing to constrained CAD
recipes.goal: Reconcile sampled surface and drawing dimensions into traceable parametric CAD.
handoffs: REC-09 segments the supplied cloud and records candidate fits.
REC-15 reconciles the supplied drawing and scan against datums; REC-14 creates CAD using resulting measurements.
REC-16 checks the CAD revision against the same source scan and reserved dimensions.
recipes.summary: The scan and drawing are supplied evidence; registration and CAD authoring results are generated in listed stages.

recipes.name: Photos, learned depth and view-synthesis comparison
recipes.goal: Compare DA3 depth/poses against SfM and use a Gaussian scene for visual context.
handoffs: REC-03 and REC-10 independently estimate camera/cloud geometry from photos.
REC-19 trains the Gaussian scene; REC-08 compares the two point clouds using supplied measurement controls.
recipes.summary: Compare learned depth estimates with photogrammetry and measured controls; Gaussian scene is a visual representation, not surface truth.

recipes.name: Gaussian context, independent mesh and CAD remodel
recipes.goal: Keep splat context separate from dense mesh evidence and editable CAD.
handoffs: REC-19 provides Gaussian PLY for appearance; REC-17 independently provides MVS cloud/mesh.
REC-14 remodels using the dense mesh and measurement set; REC-16 compares CAD with the generated cloud/mesh.
recipes.summary: The splat supports rendered context; the separately generated and checked MVS mesh supplies visible-surface evidence for CAD.

recipes.name: 3D-anchored sketch and CAD edit comparison
recipes.goal: Turn screen strokes into surface anchors, then author and compare a constrained CAD interpretation.
handoffs: REC-13 stores world-space ray hits and source element IDs in measurement-set.
REC-14 requires a separate sketch interpretation and produces editable CAD from mesh plus measurements.
REC-16 compares the CAD to the same mesh and measurements.
recipes.summary: Ray hits produce anchors only; the supplied measurements and mesh support a separately constrained CAD interpretation.

recipes.name: Photogrammetry visual scene for downstream cameras
recipes.goal: Create navigable view synthesis while retaining camera and capture provenance.
handoffs: REC-03 estimates cameras from the photo set.
REC-19 trains and exports Gaussian PLY. REC-20 is the NeRF alternative with the same produced camera solution.
recipes.summary: The Gaussian recipe yields a view-synthesis scene; choosing the NeRF alternative replaces REC-19 with REC-20.

recipes.name: RGB-D metric scan and CAD comparison
recipes.goal: Fuse calibrated depth frames and compare the result to a known CAD revision.
handoffs: REC-05 produces camera trajectory and cloud; REC-06 produces TSDF mesh.
REC-12 aligns CAD to the scan cloud or mesh using supplied measurements; REC-16 compares that registration and CAD revision.
recipes.summary: Sensor calibration gives the scan scale and frame; controls test drift, and CAD comparison uses registered measured surfaces.

recipes.name: Single-image mesh proxy and evidence-based remodel
recipes.goal: Generate a visual proxy, then build CAD from independently supplied dimensions and measured evidence.
handoffs: REC-18 generates the mesh proxy from the supplied single-image photo set.
REC-14 requires the measurement set and proxy mesh; dimensions and hidden geometry must retain their evidence labels.
REC-16 checks the CAD against the proxy and supplied controls; proxy agreement is not independent validation.
recipes.summary: The image generates a mesh proxy; measurement-set supplies dimensional evidence for any CAD remodeling.

ideas.name: Pose and unit adapter fixture across tool frames
ideas.summary: Create a small surveyed fixture with known 3D targets and images; round-trip pose matrices through OpenCV, COLMAP, Open3D, Blender and OCS, checking direction, handedness, units and projection error.
ideas.next_check: Confirm exact conventions and transform serialization supported by the installed versions.

ideas.name: Multi-sensor RGB-depth-LiDAR frame graph
ideas.summary: Represent camera intrinsics, RGB-depth extrinsics, LiDAR-to-camera transform, world controls and frame timestamps as one provenance-linked transform graph before fusion.
ideas.next_check: Define schema for transform direction, units, covariance/residual and calibration revision.

ideas.name: DA3 metric and COLMAP/MVS comparison on control object
ideas.summary: Capture an object with distributed measured controls and compare DA3 estimated depth/pose/cloud against COLMAP/MVS and independent lengths, reporting regional residuals.
ideas.next_check: Select nonreflective textured object and set held-out control distances before capture.

ideas.name: Camera-anchored stroke primitive semantics
ideas.summary: Use ray hits to anchor strokes and offer separate interpretations: surface trace, projected curve, selected planar sketch, or dimensioned datum annotation; store source component/face and camera state.
ideas.next_check: Specify user interaction for ambiguous occlusion and backface hits, then verify reprojected anchors.

ideas.name: Nerfstudio Splatfacto geometry export version test
ideas.summary: Resolve generic `ns-export tsdf` documentation (states all models) against Splatfacto FAQ (states mesh/pointcloud unsupported) for selected release and checkpoint.
ideas.next_check: At authorized implementation stage, identify version and test `ns-export tsdf` output existence, coverage, units and withheld control residuals.

ideas.name: Primitive-fitting method selection
ideas.summary: Compare plane, circle/cylinder/axis candidate fitters on known reference geometry, retain inlier point IDs and residual distribution, and compare fit stability under threshold changes.
ideas.next_check: Choose feature classes needed by actual scan-to-CAD fixture and document each fitter's objective and units.

ideas.name: CAD-to-cloud correspondence strategy
ideas.summary: Compare CAD semantic landmarks/PnP against FPFH/RANSAC+ICP for aligning scan to an existing CAD revision, especially partial and symmetric shapes.
ideas.next_check: Use withheld datum targets and report alternate pose failure cases.

ideas.name: Splat plus independently checked mesh layered scene
ideas.summary: Keep Gaussian splat for appearance, point cloud for sampled evidence, mesh for surface comparison and CAD solids for interpreted design as named layers carrying linked transforms and confidence/evidence labels.
ideas.next_check: Define a scene manifest with representation role, transform, unit, source and checks for each layer.
